description: This Java class defines the configuration for geofencing calculated fields within the Thingsboard platform, including entity references, zone groups, scheduling options, and output settings.

classes.name: GeofencingCalculatedFieldConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for geofencing calculated fields, managing entity references, zone groups, scheduling, and output type.

methods.name: isUseLatestTs
methods.description: Determines if the configuration uses the latest time series data based on output type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of calculated field, which is GEOFENCING.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Collects and returns arguments derived from entity coordinates and zone groups.

methods.name: getReferencedEntities
methods.description: Returns a set of entity IDs referenced by the zone groups.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the configuration, ensuring scheduled update interval is set if scheduling is enabled, and validates each zone group.
